note: Harder questions (2026-10-17). Answers from the parsed manual pages, or from the asset's parts list where marked. `kind`: words = operator words, no codes; two = needs two facts; manual = a part whose manual has no graph facts (RAG only); parts = the parts list only; unknown = not in any document, the right answer says so. `forbid`: regexes a wrong answer would state (a found one makes the answer ✗). `abstain`: the expected fact is that the answer says it is not documented.

questions.question: The main drive is complaining about its cooling fan. What does that mean and what should I check?
questions.answer: A581 Fan: cooling fan feedback missing; check 95.20 HW options word 1 bit 14, identify the fan by the auxiliary code, check and replace the fan
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.601

questions.question: The main drive tripped because the current got too high. What should I check?
questions.answer: 2310 Overcurrent: check motor load; 95.04 Control board supply if externally powered; acceleration times (groups 23/26/28); scaling 46.1-46.3; motor and motor cable (phasing, delta/star); no PF capacitors or surge absorbers
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.579

questions.question: The main drive stopped and says the DC voltage is too low. What is the likely cause?
questions.answer: DC link undervoltage: fault 3220 (missing supply phase, blown fuse or fault in the rectifier bridge; check supply cabling, fuses and switchgear) or warning A3A2 when the drive is stopped (check the supply voltage setting 95.01 and the supply voltage)
questions.source: ACS880 Primary control program firmware manual, p.582 (3220) and p.598 (A3A2)

questions.question: The extruder motor is running hot. What could cause that?
questions.answer: Overload (reduce load); frame or ventilation openings full of dirt; one phase open; grounded coil (rewind); unbalanced terminal voltage
questions.source: Low voltage motors manual 3GZF500730-85, Table 10.1, p.26

questions.question: The extruder motor bearings are getting hot. What should I look at?
questions.answer: Hot bearings: bent or sprung shaft; excessive belt pull; pulleys too far from the shaft shoulder; pulley diameter too small
questions.source: Low voltage motors manual 3GZF500730-85, Table 10.1, p.26

questions.question: Our main drive has been sitting unpowered for more than a year. What must be done before starting it?
questions.answer: Reform the DC link capacitors (converter module capacitor reforming instructions 3BFE64059629)
questions.source: ACS880-07 hardware manual, p.26 (also p.208)

questions.question: How often should the main drive cabinet's door filters be changed?
questions.answer: Every year: the IP54 cabinet door filters are replaced annually
questions.source: ACS880-07 hardware manual, p.176

questions.question: The steam valve actuator has no power and I need to move the valve. How do I do it by hand?
questions.answer: With the motor at a standstill, pull the coupling lever and turn the handwheel left or right until it engages
questions.source: Spiratrol EL5000 IM-P321-06, 1.3, p.2

questions.question: How do I clean the inside of the main drive cabinet?
questions.answer: Stop the drive and follow the electrical safety precautions; use an antistatic wrist strap and a vacuum cleaner with an antistatic hose and nozzle, and a soft brush; clean the fan air inlets, the module air outlets and the door gratings
questions.source: ACS880-07 hardware manual, p.177

questions.question: How often should the oil in the main gearbox be changed?
questions.answer: First oil change after 500 operating hours; then mineral oil at least every 3 years and synthetic oil at least every 5 years, depending on operating conditions; check the oil consistency every 3000 h, at least every 6 months
questions.source: SEW X..e series gear units, 7.2, p.85

questions.question: What drives the cutter, and what should I do when it shows F07801?
questions.answer: A Siemens SINAMICS G120C (7.5 kW); F07801 Motor overcurrent: check current limits (p0640), the current limiting controller in U/f (p1340-p1346), increase the ramp-up time (p1120) or reduce the load, check motor and cables for short-circuit and ground fault, check star/delta and rating plate data
questions.source: Parts list; SINAMICS G120C operating instructions, p.385

questions.question: The feed screw drive trips with F30001. What should I check?
questions.answer: F30001 Overcurrent: motor data (commission again if needed), motor connection star/delta, U/f rated currents of motor and power module, line quality, line commutating reactor, power cable connections, power cables for short-circuit or ground fault
questions.source: SINAMICS G120C operating instructions, p.386

questions.question: Do the cutter motor bearings need regreasing? If not, when should they be replaced?
questions.answer: No: in the standard version, 1LE1 motors up to shaft height 250 have permanently lubricated (maintenance-free) bearings; replace them after 40,000 h in horizontal coupled operation at 40 °C (20,000 h vertical or with axial and radial forces)
questions.source: SIMOTICS GP/SD 1LE1 operating instructions, 3.3.2 p.28 and Table 9-4 p.107

questions.question: How should I clean the lens of the infrared thermometer at the product discharge?
questions.answer: Blow off loose particles with clean compressed air, then clean with a soft humid tissue (water) or a lens cleaner; never use solvent-based cleaners
questions.source: optris CT operator's manual, 1.4, p.10

questions.question: How should the die pressure transmitter be removed and cleaned?
questions.answer: Remove it only with the machine empty (no pressure) but still hot; clean it with solvents for the processed material; no mechanical action on the diaphragm, which could break it
questions.source: Gefran pressure sensors for high temperature 85184G, p.20

questions.question: What is the highest temperature the die pressure transmitter's diaphragm can take?
questions.answer: 315 °C (600 °F): the WE0 is an oil-filled W series sensor (W series up to 315 °C; M series 400 °C, K series 538 °C)
questions.source: Gefran pressure sensors for high temperature 85184G, p.3 and p.19 (W series oil filling)

questions.question: How often should the steam control valve be inspected, and what should be replaced at that time?
questions.answer: Annually: inspect for wear and replace worn parts (plug and stem, seat, gland seals); replace graphite gland packing at this routine inspection; replace all soft seals and gaskets when the valve is taken apart
questions.source: Spira-trol K and L series IM-S24-42, 4.2, p.47

questions.question: How should the water injection flow meter be cleaned?
questions.answer: No special maintenance; clean outside surfaces with a lint-free cloth, dry or slightly damp with water; no sharp objects or aggressive cleaning agents; no high-pressure steam
questions.source: Proline Promag H 300 BA01392D, 13.1.1, p.159

questions.question: How often must the barrel temperature sensors be calibrated?
questions.answer: No fixed interval: RTD inserts may drift depending on the application, so regular recalibration is recommended, by the manufacturer or by qualified staff with calibration devices on site
questions.source: iTHERM ModuLine TM411 BA02023T, p.20

questions.question: How do I do a routine zero on the belt scale integrator?
questions.answer: Meet the calibration criteria; press the zero key; with the belt clear (empty, running), press ENTER to start; at the end accept the deviation and new zero count with ENTER
questions.source: Milltronics BW500 operating instructions, 6.4.1, p.72

questions.question: Which parts of the main drive need replacing 9 years after start-up?
questions.answer: Main cooling fan (R10 and R11), circuit board compartment cooling fans (R10 and R11), cabinet internal and door fans (50 Hz) and IP54 fans; replaced again at 18 years
questions.source: ACS880-07 hardware manual, p.176

questions.question: The main drive shows a fan warning and the extruder motor is overheating. What should I check on each?
questions.answer: Drive: A581 cooling fan feedback missing, check 95.20 bit 14 and the fan by the auxiliary code. Motor: overload, dirty ventilation openings, an open phase, grounded coil, unbalanced voltage
questions.source: ACS880 firmware manual p.601; Low voltage motors manual Table 10.1, p.26

questions.question: Which instrument measures the steam flow, and which device positions the steam valve?
questions.answer: Endress+Hauser Proline Prowirl F 200 vortex meter (DN40); Spirax Sarco Spiratrol EL5000 electric linear actuator
questions.source: Parts list (EXTR01_bom.csv)

questions.question: Which motors on the extruder are made by Siemens, and how powerful are they?
questions.answer: Cutter motor SIMOTICS GP 1LE1 7.5 kW and feed screw motor SIMOTICS GP 1LE1 5.5 kW (both 4-pole, IE3)
questions.source: Parts list (EXTR01_bom.csv)

questions.question: How many barrel heating zones are there, and what controls the heater power and temperature in each?
questions.answer: Three zones; each has a Watlow DIN-A-MITE C solid-state power controller and a Watlow EZ-ZONE PM PLUS (PM6) temperature controller
questions.source: Parts list (EXTR01_bom.csv)
